name: RiskOnBlast
rootCause: RiskOnBlast, a gambling and trading platform on the new ethereum layer-2 Blast blockchain, appears to be a rug pull. On February 25, the platform drained more than 420 ETH (~$1.3 million) from more than 750 user wallets on their platform.

descriptions.text: RiskOnBlast, a gambling and trading platform on the new ethereum layer-2 Blast blockchain, appears to be a rug pull. On February 25, the platform drained more than 420 ETH (~$1.3 million) from more than 750 user wallets on their platform.

RiskOnBlast, a GambleFi project on Blast, executed an exit scam on 24,25 February 2024 by withdrawing over 420 ETH (~$1.3M) from its IDO contract, dispersing assets to exchanges and mixers, and deleting all online presence. No recovery efforts have succeeded. The project team used their control over the IDO contract to withdraw user deposits and launder funds, then erased their online footprint. As a classic exit scam, no technical safeguard prevented this rug pull.
